chunks: When they are called to God and His Prophet, that he may judge between them, a section of them turns away.
ai.seo_question: What is the reaction of the hypocrites or disbelievers when called to the judgment of God and His Prophet?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the incident of the hypocrites (Munafiqun) who, despite claiming faith, rejected the authority of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and later the Imams when it conflicted with their worldly interests. It underscores the principle that true submission requires accepting divine judgment in all matters, not just those that are convenient, highlighting the spiritual deficiency of those who selectively obey.
